learning_outcomes.text: Students will be familiar with basic terminology of computer networks and principles of their operation.
They will have practical experience with usage and configuration of technologies commonly used on local networks and on the internet.

syllabus_topics: Basic network terminology, layer models, OSI, TCP/IP
Network layer – IP, routing, ICMP, ARP.
Application layer – DNS, DHCP, Web, Mail, FTP, ...
Security – firewall, VPN, SSL/TLS, security at the application layer (Web, Mail).
assessment_rules: During the semester, exercises and a mid-term test each contribute 50% to the preliminary grade. A written final exam requires at least 50% to pass. An oral final exam may be waived. The overall assessment is scaled 40% preliminary and 60% final. The approximate grading scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%.
